label: Drop the v2 schema once no relation is left in it

execute.description: drop schema v2 without CASCADE, and refuse while a relation remains

postcheck.sql:
SELECT count(*) = 0 AS "result"
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname = 'v2'
